declaration.negotiation_history_statement: As interim class counsel, Hargrove Lane LLP negotiated the settlement with Brightline’s counsel through an exchange of proposals and counterproposals. The parties negotiated class relief and attorneys’ fees during the same discussions; it would not be accurate to say that fees were first discussed only after class relief was agreed. The resulting agreement provides a $30,500,000 class fund, automatic payments to identified class members, and a separate request for up to $6,250,000 in fees and expenses, subject to Court approval. Brightline will not oppose a properly supported fee request, and any amount not awarded will be paid to the class rather than returned to Brightline. The Court should independently scrutinize the fee request and clear-sailing provision. Counsel supports preliminary approval because the substantial, automatic recovery avoids the risks of class certification and trial, as well as years of further litigation.
